description: This file contains functions and types for extracting archive files (zip, tar.gz, tar.bz2), including preflight checks, hash verification, and staged extraction, specific to skills installation in a project.

methods.name: hashFileSha256
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a file at a given path.

methods.name: commandFailureResult
methods.description: Constructs an ArchiveExtractResult indicating failure with fallback stderr.

methods.name: buildTarExtractArgv
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for tar extraction with optional strip components.

methods.name: readTarPreflight
methods.description: Performs preflight checks on a tar archive, listing entries and metadata.

methods.name: isArchiveExtractFailure
methods.description: Type guard to check if a result indicates an archive extraction failure.

methods.name: verifyArchiveHashStable
methods.description: Verifies if the archive's hash matches the expected hash to ensure stability.

methods.name: extractTarBz2WithStaging
methods.description: Extracts a tar.bz2 archive using staging to ensure safe extraction.

methods.name: extractArchive
methods.description: Main function to extract archives of various types with preflight and safety checks.
